Payments<[any], uncapped>.narrower: Payments<[inbound-senders], uncapped> is not right either; the payee is the recipient of last month's bill payment, so the narrowest fit is a payee list limited to that recipient (not known in advance) with a cap equal to last month's amount. Use a Payments grant restricted to the one past recipient rather than any.
